text:
incident-bot: [AUTO-ALERT] GPU memory pressure: infer-west2a gpu-pool-03 crossed threshold. metric=cuda_oom_rate spike. PagerDuty PD-3342. https://metrics.redwood.local/alerts/3342
pagerduty: Page fired to oncall (sasha) — HIGH urgency
sasha: acked in PD :white_check_mark: I'm on it, checking the pool now
sasha: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu-pool-03` shows several pods restarting / OOM evictions
sasha: grabbing recent logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:15:10Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T02:15:11Z] eviction: preempting low-priority jobs
[2026-03-17T02:15:13Z] model-runner[pid=4212]: KV cache alloc failed 0x7ff..
```
raj: can you run `rdwctl pool inspect gpu-pool-03 --detail` and paste output? i'll prep a drain plan if needed
sasha: output:
```
total_gpus: 8
allocated: 7
avg_mem_util: 91%
kv_cache_fragmentation: 22%
active_high_prio_jobs: 4
queued_low_prio: 12
```
raj: ok — high mem util + fragmentation. start rolling drain of non-prod: `rdwctl jobs drain --pool gpu-pool-03 --label env=staging --grace 30s`
sasha: started drain for env=staging :rocket: Command returned: 12 jobs scheduled for graceful termination
sasha: also enabled fallback routing for critical customer model CustA -> model-small: `rdwctl route set --customer custA --fallback model-small`
maria: noticing error-rate increase for custA and custC in SLO dashboard — 5xxs up ~6% since alert
sasha: customer impact: degraded latency and increased 5xx for 2 customers (custA, custC). No secrets/exfil detected. Support and PMs notified via #support-updates
raj: autoscale tried but pool hit quota. @steve can you provision 2 extra GPU nodes in west2? we need capacity to absorb high-prio jobs
steve: provisioning 2 x p4-like nodes now, ETA ~3m. will post when nodes join the cluster
incident-bot: Note: PD escalation window hit condition reset (alert acknowledged)
sasha: eviction rate decreasing, mem util down to ~68% after drains. KV cache fragmentation still notable; tracking
maria: I'll own customer comms and ongoing monitoring. Will update support tickets with degraded-quality notice.
sasha: handing off active monitoring to maria. Follow-ups: (1) postmortem to runbook kv-cache eviction heuristics, (2) increase pool margin for west2, (3) add guardrail to route critical customers to fallback earlier.
maria: ack — monitoring until resolved, will loop in eng-runtime for kv-cache improvements. :thumbsup:
steve: nodes joined, cluster capacity +16 GPUs. confirming scheduler rebalanced high-prio jobs.
maria: observed 5xxs dropping back toward baseline, latency improving. closing active PD alert when stable for 10m.
sasha: thanks team. leaving ops-note: PD-3342 handled via drains + provisioning; handoff complete.
__notes: Each message line is a chronological message in a single thread string as required by agents.md. No title field included.
